name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
🧹 Deep Chromium & APK Cache Purge: Auto-wipes hidden WebView HTTP/GPU caches and update APKs, bringing App Info cache down to near zero automatically.
⚡ Instant Drive Status Detection: Real-time detection of 404 deleted or 403 private Google Drive folders with clear actionable user guidance.
🔌 Auto-Clearing Analysis Error: Plugin now instantly clears stale timeouts and reconnects seamlessly with in-process background daemon.
🚀 Low-End Device RAM & Smoothness: High-efficiency RGB_565 decoding and hardware acceleration eliminate lags and device heating.
